estimate_note: 20s overhead + 2 * shots * sum(circuit duration + explicitly set repetition delay); heuristic, not guarantee
budget_value_kind: Uncommitted lower bound after reserving caps of known pending jobs; submission checks again.

statistics_plan.comparison: Same-job original baseline; postselected winners additionally need same-layout baseline.
statistics_plan.selection: Exploratory screen, freeze candidate before independent confirmation, preserve all failures.
statistics_plan.scope: Best among tested layouts and circuits, not a global optimum proof.
statistics_plan.selection_detail: Compare all candidates; a postselected winner must beat the same-layout unprotected control as well as the original baseline in two fresh jobs. If postselection has no supported benefit, prefer all-shot baseline with strong fidelity and no discarded data. Screening rankings alone are exploratory.
